semantic_rules: FACT = deterministic observation, must not mix with inferences
CONSTRAINT = hard boundaries and resource limits
INFERENCE = non-factual hypotheses, explicitly separate from facts
EVIDENCE_REF = compact pointer (path#Lxx-Lyy), never full text dumps
